disease_to_advice.Flu: Rest, drink plenty of fluids, and consider over-the-counter pain relievers.
disease_to_advice.Common Cold: Stay hydrated, rest, and use throat lozenges if needed.
disease_to_advice.COVID-19: Isolate yourself, wear a mask, and seek emergency care if you have trouble breathing.
disease_to_advice.Migraine: Rest in a quiet, dark room. Apply a cold compress to your head.
disease_to_advice.Asthma: Use your prescribed inhaler and avoid known triggers.
disease_to_advice.Diabetes: Monitor your blood sugar levels and adhere to your dietary plan.
disease_to_advice.Hypertension: Reduce sodium intake, manage stress, and monitor your blood pressure.
disease_to_advice.Food Poisoning: Stay hydrated with water or electrolyte solutions. Eat bland foods.
disease_to_advice.Kidney Infection: Drink plenty of water and complete any prescribed antibiotic courses.
disease_to_advice.Arthritis: Engage in gentle exercises and use hot/cold therapy for joint pain.
